name: soulmate
description: It verifies what you asked an agent to do and what came back, in the same record. Use it as an opt-in, bounded project guidance surface; ordinary work remains unchanged. Plugin installation provides host guidance and does not install the separate soulmate CLI.

interface.shortDescription: Inspectable handoffs for a configured project
interface.longDescription: It verifies what you asked an agent to do and what came back, in the same record. Use it as an opt-in, bounded project guidance surface; ordinary work remains unchanged. Plugin installation provides host guidance and does not install the separate soulmate CLI.
defaultPrompt: Use Soulmate with this configured project for a bounded, inspectable handoff.

systems.veyndra.soulmate.purpose: Preserved host-hook compatibility resources; host-specific activation is not implied.
